tools.name: daylily.search_cultivars
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find public daylily cultivar reference records by name, hybridizer, color, parentage, or general search text. Do not use it to answer questions about a signed-in user's own inventory; use daylily.list_listings for that. Prefer specific fields over q when the user asks

tools.name: daylily.get_cultivar
tools.description: Use this when the user has a Daylily Catalog cultivarReferenceId or normalizedName and needs the exact public cultivar record. Do not use it for fuzzy search; call daylily.search_cultivars first.

tools.name: daylily.search_public_listings
tools.description: Use this when a buyer asks for public Daylily Catalog inventory, growers, prices, photos, or availability-style searches. Returns only public listings from active catalogs and never includes private notes or hidden listings. Prefer specific filters over q and follow nextCursor until null for complet

tools.name: daylily.get_public_listing
tools.description: Use this when a buyer asks for one public listing by listing id, or by sellerSlug plus listingSlug. Returns public listing details only; hidden listings and private notes are excluded.

tools.name: daylily.list_public_profiles
tools.description: Browse active public grower catalogs with listings. Returns a bounded page of seller summaries ordered by seller id; follow nextCursor for more. Use get_public_profile for one grower's full profile.

tools.name: daylily.get_public_profile
tools.description: Use this when a buyer asks about a public grower or catalog profile by seller slug. Returns public seller profile, public lists, profile images, and public listing/list counts.

tools.name: daylily.list_public_profile_lists
tools.description: Use this when a buyer asks what public lists or collections a seller has. Use the returned list ids with daylily.list_public_listings.

tools.name: daylily.list_public_listings
tools.description: Use this when a buyer asks to browse one seller's public catalog or one public list. Requires sellerSlug, and can filter by listId, listTitle, cultivar, color, price, photos, hybridizer, parentage, or year. Returns only public listings.

tools.name: daylily.search_help
tools.description: Use this for short, sourced help with public cultivar search or member dashboard workflows, such as listing status, lists, photos, profile content, import, and billing. It does not read member records.

tools.name: daylily.get_profile
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in user asks about their own Daylily Catalog profile, storefront copy, slug, location, images, or public profile content. Story content is read-only through remote MCP; use open_dashboard with edit_profile_content to edit it. The image IDs support reorder and dashboard remov

tools.name: daylily.list_lists
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in user asks to browse their catalog lists or resolve a list name to an id. Set listingId to page the lists containing one owned listing. Returns each list's title, description, status, and id. Use daylily.list_listings with listId to page a list's members. Requires OAuth.

tools.name: daylily.get_list
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in user asks to inspect one list by id, including its description, status, and dashboard link. Call daylily.list_listings with listId for paged members. Requires OAuth.

tools.name: daylily.list_listings
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in user asks to search, filter, or page through their own listings. Returns compact rows. Follow nextCursor until null; a filtered page can be empty and still have a nextCursor. For cultivar details, first call daylily.search_cultivars on the public index, then filter owned

tools.name: daylily.get_listing
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in user asks to inspect one exact listing by id, including private notes, images, linked cultivar data, and up to 100 list memberships. If listsNextCursor is present, call daylily.list_lists with listingId and that cursor for the remaining memberships. If imagesHasMore is tr

tools.name: daylily.list_images
tools.description: Page every image ID for one owned listing or profile. Pages are ordered by image ID; use each image's order field for display order. Follow nextCursor until null before reordering or preparing removal review for a large legacy image set. Requires OAuth.

tools.name: daylily.get_image
tools.description: Get one owned listing or profile image by ID, including its resolved dashboard image URL. Use get_listing, get_profile, or list_images to find image IDs first. Requires OAuth.

tools.name: daylily.open_dashboard
tools.description: Use this when the signed-in member needs a precise dashboard screen to add listing or profile photos, edit a profile story or URL, or review deletion, image removal, story block removal, cultivar unlinking, or list member removal. Use manage_listing_images with the owned listing id or manage_profile

tools.name: daylily.create_listing
tools.description: Create one listing. Non-Pro accounts can have up to 25 listings, including hidden listings. Set hidden=true to keep it private or hidden=false to publish it. Supply a unique requestId and reuse it when retrying the same creation. Requires a connected account and the catalog:write OAuth scope. Accoun

tools.name: daylily.update_listing
tools.description: Edit one owned listing. Supply the updatedAt value from the listing read. Omitted fields remain unchanged; null clears an optional field. Requires a connected account and the catalog:write OAuth scope. Account tier limits apply.

tools.name: daylily.create_list
tools.description: Create one list. Non-Pro accounts can have up to 1 list. Supply a unique requestId and reuse it when retrying the same creation. Requires a connected account and the catalog:write OAuth scope. Account tier limits apply.

tools.name: daylily.update_list
tools.description: Edit the title or description of one owned list. Supply the updatedAt value from the list read. Requires a connected account and the catalog:write OAuth scope. Account tier limits apply.

tools.name: daylily.add_listing_to_list
tools.description: Add one owned listing to one owned list. Repeating this call leaves the membership in place. Requires a connected account and the catalog:write OAuth scope. Account tier limits apply.

tools.name: daylily.link_listing_to_cultivar
tools.description: Link one listing to a cultivar reference. An existing different link must be reviewed in the dashboard before replacement. Requires a connected account and the catalog:write OAuth scope. Account tier limits apply.

tools.name: daylily.sync_listing_cultivar_name
tools.description: Set one owned listing's title and URL slug to the name of its linked cultivar reference. Read the listing again if the link changes. Requires a connected account and the catalog:write OAuth scope. Account tier limits apply.

tools.name: daylily.update_profile
tools.description: Edit the title, description, or location of the member's public profile. Supply updatedAt from the profile read, or null if no profile exists. Open manage_profile_images to add profile photos. Use reorder_images to change their order. Open the dashboard for profile URL or story changes. Requires a c

tools.name: daylily.reorder_images
tools.description: Place selected images first in the given order on one owned listing or profile. Other images keep their relative order. Requires a connected account and the catalog:write OAuth scope. Account tier limits apply.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "server" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: daylily.get_profile, daylily.list_images, daylily.get_image, daylily.open_dashboard, daylily.sync_listing_cultivar_name, daylily.update_profile · Private data: daylily.search_cultivars, daylily.get_cultivar, daylily.search_public_listings, daylily.get_public_listing, daylily.search_help, daylily.list_listings, daylily.get_listing, daylily.create_listing · Public sink: daylily.create_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: daylily.get_profile, daylily.list_images, daylily.get_image, daylily.open_dashboard, daylily.sync_listing_cultivar_name, daylily.update_profile · Private data: daylily.search_cultivars, daylily.get_cultivar, daylily.search_public_listings, daylily.get_public_listing, daylily.search_help, daylily.list_listings, daylily.get_listing, daylily.create_listing · Public sink: daylily.create_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
